description: The article introduces a proof-of-concept methodology combining a drawing-based survey with network analysis of the cataloged drawing elements.
title: Drawing-based survey and network analysis methodology for studying learning-community perceptions

description: DReaM (Deterministic Relativistic and Middle ground) is an integrative framework offered by the authors that organizes learners' uncertainty articulations into nine sub-categories spanning three reasoning domains.
title: DReaM framework: nine sub-categories of uncertainty articulations integrating statistical, scientific and nature of science uncertainty
